subject: Stonebridge: bank account transfer + PO remapping
body:
From: Sophie Martin <sophie.martin@stonebridgeco.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Finance Portal <payments@stonebridgeco.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Stonebridge bank transfer and PO remap

Hi Rachel,

Quick note — Stonebridge is consolidating its treasury operations. Effective 2026-10-01 we'd like all new invoices and future POs to route to a new beneficiary bank. Attached is the bank transfer letter from our treasury team and an updated W-9.

Can you confirm what steps you need from our side to update the vendor record and remap outstanding POs so future payments go to the new account? We prefer minimal downtime — we still have three open POs (PO #45321, #45378, #45502) that should be captured under the new remit.

Thanks,
Sophie Martin
Head of Revenue Operations
Stonebridge Co.
Attachments: stonebridge_bank_letter.pdf; w9_stonebridge.pdf

---
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Martin <sophie.martin@stonebridgeco.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Stonebridge bank transfer and PO remap

Hi Sophie — thanks for the heads up and for the attachments. We can support the change but need three items to proceed:

1) The signed vendor update form (official authorization for Redwood to change remit details).
2) A bank letter or voided check, signed by treasury (you provided; thanks).
3) Confirmation whether the change should apply to existing open POs (you mentioned 45321, 45378, 45502) or only to invoices generated after 2026-10-01.

Internal note: looping in Karthik (Procurement) for PO remapping and Monica (AP) to run the vendor verification and schedule the portal update.

Next steps: Sophie, if you can sign the vendor update form and reply, Monica will triage the portal change and run a micro-deposit verification if required by banking policy. If everything looks good we'll aim to have portal and PO remapping completed by 2026-09-21 to give a buffer before your effective date.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Sr. Strategic Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

---
From: Sophie Martin <sophie.martin@stonebridgeco.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 16 Sep 2026 08:27:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Stonebridge bank transfer and PO remap

Rachel — attached is the signed vendor update form and a PDF of the bank letter with signature. We want the change applied to all invoices dated 2026-10-01 and later, but we also need the three open POs remapped so invoices against those POs route to the new account. Please treat PO #45321 as urgent.

Attachments: signed_vendor_update_form.pdf; stonebridge_bank_letter.pdf

Regards,
Sophie

---
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sophie Martin <sophie.martin@stonebridgeco.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Sep 2026 10:15:00 -0400
Subject: RE: Stonebridge bank transfer and PO remap

Thanks Sophie — received the signed form and bank letter. Per our vendor onboarding controls I will: 

- Upload the signed form and W-9 into the vendor profile (Vendor ID: VND-98124).
- Queue the AP team to schedule a micro-deposit to the new account (expected 1–2 business days).
- Place a hold on automated ACH until micro-deposit confirms.
- Remap PO #45321 and #45378 to the new remit once micro-deposit succeeds; I'll hold PO #45502 pending confirmation from Treasury for any special instructions.

Karthik — can you confirm if Procurement needs a PO amendment or if we should create a short addendum to the PO that notes the remit change? Also tagging Laura for review in case Legal wants a signature on a PO amendment.

Monica Patel
Accounts Payable Lead
Redwood Inference

Attachment stub: w9_stonebridge.pdf

---
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Sophie Martin <sophie.martin@stonebridgeco.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 16:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Stonebridge bank transfer and PO remap

All — procurement is fine with an addendum rather than reissuing full POs. Monica, please prepare a short PO remap addendum that references the original PO numbers and the effective remit date (2026-10-01). Laura — if Legal prefers a different format, please flag edits by EOD Monday.

Sophie — we'll proceed with the micro-deposit verification and, on success, apply the remap for PO #45321 and #45378. We'll pause PO #45502 until we hear your treasury note about special instructions. Expect a confirmation email after micro-deposit clears.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference

[End of thread]
